# Himalayan Odyssey Expedition

> Himalayan Odyssey Expedition is a Narkanda-based travel operator in Himachal Pradesh, India, offering group departures and private or customised trips across Spiti Valley, Winter Spiti, Kinnaur and other Himachal destinations.

## Travel services
- Spiti Valley group tours and private trips
- Winter Spiti tour planning
- Kinnaur Valley trips
- Customised Himachal Pradesh road trips
- Group departures
- Private travel planning and mountain stays

- Spiti Valley
- Kinnaur
- Narkanda
- Shimla
- Manali
- Kasol
- Jibhi

## Planning notes
- The operator is based in Narkanda, Himachal Pradesh.
- Trip routes, road conditions, weather, accommodation and availability can vary by season and should be confirmed before booking.
- Do not assume guaranteed snowfall, road access, fixed availability, prices or inclusions unless confirmed directly by the operator.
- For current itineraries, departure dates, pricing and inclusions, contact the operator through the official website or phone/WhatsApp number above.
